You are looking for an employer who takes you to the next level. You want to work on a team which values your ideas. You want to participate in developing and creating the future of BBHT Solutions. Then join us as
Cloud Engineer - Azure (TOSM)
Your responsibilities
Build and manage Azure infrastructure using Terraform (IaC)
Translate business and regulatory requirements into secure cloud solutions
Implement security controls (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) and enforce Azure Policies & IAM
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab / Bitbucket)
Support deployments (plan/apply, approvals, validation) and LAB testing
Contribute to modules, code reviews, and state management
Monitor environments and validate policy compliance 
Collaborate with Security, Compliance, and business teams
 Your Qualifications
Strong experience with Azure, Terraform (advanced), and CI/CD (Git-based)
Knowledge of Azure governance, Policies, and IAM
Experience with GitLab/Bitbucket, VS Code, and basic scripting
Background in security controls (e.g., CIS Benchmarks)
Ability to translate regulatory requirements into technical solutions
Experience with Policy-as-Code and structured deployments
Collaborative, hands-on, and delivery-focused mindset 
Very good written and spoken communication skills in both German and English
 We offer you
A full-time position and the chance to collectively develop the company itself
Independent work, challenging & innovative projects with renowned clients
Qualified and continuing education, joint trainings and company events
Good work-life balance by flexible working hours and 25 days of vacation
Remote or hybrid work and high quality, personal IT infrastructure
 BBHT is an ambitious consultancy shaped by its employees, with offices in Cluj-Napoca (Romania), Münster and Frankfurt am Main (Germany). We specialize in project and process management, requirement engineering, business intelligence and quality assurance and regulatory reporting, our main focus being the banking and insurance sector. Our mission: to solve new challenges together with motivated people.
Let’s get to know each other! Send your application to careers@bbhtsolutions.ro or mihaela.grama@bbht-solutions.ro, or give us a call at +40 364 631 9 05.
